raw_response:
Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows multiple ill-defined nodular opacities, particularly in the right mid and left upper zones. In the context of Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), these findings are characteristic of pulmonary arteriovenous malformations (PAVMs), and the presence of a visible feeding artery and draining vein is the pathognomonic radiological sign confirming this diagnosis.
